Check out dancers performing the Jingpo sword dance to the song Munao Zongge. In the Jingpo language, Munao Zongge means "singing and dancing." It is a thousand-year-old communal dance that celebrates blessings, joy, and cultural exchange.
The song recently went viral online, inspiring dancer Yuan Zhiping to create this sword dance. Some traditions never fade. They just grow stronger.
#Jingpo #Yunnan #ChineseCulture #EthnicDance #CulturalHeritage #FestivalVibes #Dance
